gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages Investors of AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTS) Who Suffered Losses to Contact the Firm Before November 13, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed securities class action lawsuits against AST SpaceMobile (ASTS), AppLovin (APP), and Bank of America (BAC) on behalf of investors who suffered losses. AST is accused of overstating its competitive advantages in the satellite D2C market and capital sufficiency. AppLovin's class period spans February to August 2026, and Bank of America's spans August 2025 to October 2026. Investors have until specified deadlines to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: AppLovin Corporation (APP) Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; November 16, 2026 Deadline- Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) for investors who purchased securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026. The lawsuit alleges material misstatements regarding AI product revenue projections, development delays in the generative AI video creative feature, and overstated AI model improvements. AppLovin's stock dropped significantly following analyst downgrades and disappointing Q2 earnings reports. The deadline to seek lead plaintiff status is November 16, 2026.

top.title: FRVO Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Fervo Energy Company, You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights

Additional class actions are also being pursued against Yiren Digital Ltd., Tenax Therapeutics, Inc., Better Home & Finance Holding Company, and AppLovin Corporation.

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against Lincoln Educational Services (LINC), FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL), and AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC

AST SpaceMobile faces claims of misleading statements about capital adequacy and liquidity (deadline Nov 13, 2026).

top.summary: D-Wave Quantum Inc. (QBTS) faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging executives made false and misleading statements about the company's business prospects. The lawsuit covers the period from February 26, 2026 to August 25, 2026, following disappointing Q2 2026 earnings ($3.08M vs. $4.03-4.08M expected) and the CFO's resignation announcement, both triggering significant stock price declines. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status by December 15, 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

Investors who purchased ASTS securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 13, 2026.

top.summary: D-Wave Quantum Inc. (QBTS) faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging executives made false and misleading statements about the company's business prospects. The lawsuit covers the period from February 26, 2026 to August 25, 2026, following disappointing Q2 2026 earnings ($3.08M vs. $4.03-4.08M expected) and the CFO's resignation announcement, both triggering significant stock price declines. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status by December 15, 2026.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against The Ensign Group, Inc. (ENSG), Netcapital Inc. (NCPL), and Webull Corporation (BULL) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC

top.summary: Cabaletta Bio announced positive Phase 1/2 clinical data for resecabtagene autoleucel (rese-cel), a CAR T cell therapy for autoimmune diseases. Results showed 100% of dermatomyositis patients maintained immunomodulator-free responses through one year, 100% of lupus nephritis patients achieved remission, and 71% of systemic sclerosis patients achieved improvement. top.title: Capricor’s HOPE-3 Phase 3 Cardiac Results for Deramiocel Win American Heart Association Outstanding Research Award in Pediatric Cardiology
top.summary: Capricor Therapeutics announced that its HOPE-3 Phase 3 trial results for Deramiocel in Duchenne muscular dystrophy received the American Heart Association's Outstanding Research Award in Pediatric Cardiology. The cardiac data showed that Deramiocel improved left ventricular ejection fraction by 2.8 percentage points in cardiomyopathy patients (p=0.02) and reduced new heart scarring by 2.9 segments compared to natural history controls (p=0.01). The company's Biologics License Application remains under FDA review with a PDUFA target action date of November 22, 2026.

top.summary: The Software Safety Institute, a new independent nonprofit, launched on November 9, 2026, to advance research and policy on software safety. Founded by Lauren Zabierek and Bob Lord, the organization aims to shift responsibility for software defects from users to manufacturers through independent research, public education, and policy frameworks. The institute argues that preventable software flaws, particularly memory safety issues known for 30 years, persist due to misaligned incentives rather than technical limitations.

top.title: CRISPR Therapeutics Provides Update on Zugocabtagene Geleucel (Zugo-cel) in Refractory Rheumatologic Autoimmune Diseases
top.summary: CRISPR Therapeutics reported encouraging Phase 1 clinical data for zugo-cel, its allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy, across multiple autoimmune disease indications. In systemic sclerosis, 83% of patients achieved clinical response at Month 3 with maintained responses through Month 6+. All nine idiopathic inflammatory myopathy patients showed moderate to major improvement. The therapy demonstrated a favorable safety profile with no serious adverse events reported across 21 dosed patients. Dose escalation studies are ongoing with higher CAR-T cell expansion observed at increased dose levels.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has issued deadline notices for securities class action lawsuits against Doximity, Inc. and Ardelyx, Inc., with a November 16, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The firm is also announcing a newly filed lawsuit against NVIDIA Corporation. Investors who purchased shares during specified class periods may be eligible for compensation.

top.title: ARDX DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, NATIONALLY REGARDED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Ardelyx, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action - ARDX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Ardelyx, Doximity, and NVIDIA. The primary case detailed involves Ardelyx, where investors who purchased stock between January 13, 2025 and August 6, 2026 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges the company made materially false statements regarding commercial performance and growth prospects for its drugs XPHOZAH and IBSRELA, while concealing reimbursement barriers and prior authorization issues that hindered patient access. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

O-I Glass investors claim the company made false statements about its Fit to Win cost-saving program and concealed operational challenges. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from November to December 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Doximity, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Doximity, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims Doximity made false statements about its Newsfeed's revenue impact, overstated market position, and misrepresented advertising practices. Investors who purchased securities between August 8, 2024 and May 13, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges The Ensign Group, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against The Ensign Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: ENSG) alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its business operations. The complaint claims Ensign's business model depends on systematic neglect of elderly residents in its facilities, including inadequate food, medical attention, and basic care, resulting in resident deaths. Additional allegations include fraudulent billing to Medicaid and Medicare, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. Investors who purchased Ensign securities between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026 are encouraged to join the class action.

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against The Ensign Group, Inc. (ENSG), Netcapital Inc. (NCPL), and Webull Corporation (BULL) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC
top.summary: Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced lead plaintiff deadlines (December 7, 2026) for shareholder class action lawsuits against The Ensign Group, Netcapital Inc., and Webull Corporation. The lawsuits allege fraudulent billing practices at Ensign, improper revenue recognition at Netcapital, and undisclosed China ties at Webull. Investors who purchased shares during the specified periods and suffered losses are encouraged to seek legal representation.

top.title: ROSEN, THE FIRST FILING FIRM, Encourages The Ensign Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - ENSG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is reminding investors in The Ensign Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: ENSG) of an important December 7, 2026 deadline to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Ensign made false statements regarding its business practices, including systematic neglect of elderly residents, fraudulent Medicaid/Medicare claims, falsification of staffing hours, and illegal licensing schemes. Investors who purchased Ensign securities between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026 may be entitled to compensation.

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against Lincoln Educational Services (LINC), FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL), and AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC
top.summary: Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced lead plaintiff deadlines for multiple shareholder class action lawsuits. Lincoln Educational Services faces allegations of false statements regarding student enrollment (deadline Nov 10, 2026). FuelCell Energy is accused of misrepresenting manufacturing capacity and financial risks (deadline Nov 10, 2026). AST SpaceMobile faces claims of misleading statements about capital adequacy and liquidity (deadline Nov 13, 2026).

top.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple ongoing securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves Everest Group, Ltd., where investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges Everest made false statements about casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves. Additional class actions are mentioned for Lincoln Educational Services Corporation and Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc., with a November 10, 2026 deadline.

top.title: LINC FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, A RANKED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 10 Deadline in Securities Class Action - LINC
top.summary: Multiple securities class action lawsuits have been filed against Lincoln Educational Services, Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Qfin Holdings, and FuelCell Energy. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are reminded of the November 10, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The lawsuits allege false and misleading statements regarding business operations and financial prospects.

top.title: DNB FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 10 Deadline in Securities Class Action - DNB
top.summary: Several securities class action lawsuits have been filed against Dun & Bradstreet Holdings (DNB), Lincoln Educational Services (LINC), Qfin Holdings (QFIN), and FuelCell Energy (FCEL). Investors who purchased or held shares during specified periods are encouraged to join the litigation before the November 10, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The DNB lawsuit alleges false and misleading statements regarding the Clearlake Capital merger valuation and omission of material facts about executive interests.

top.summary: Firefly Aerospace has been selected as a vendor under NASA's $10 billion Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) 2 contract, enabling the company to compete for task orders over a 10-year period. Following the successful Blue Ghost Mission 1 lunar landing in March 2025, Firefly is scaling up its lander technology to deliver heavier cargo and infrastructure for NASA's Moon Base and Artemis program. The company has also won four additional CLPS 1 missions and is expanding production capabilities.

top.title: GREENWAY TECHNOLOGIES SIGNS BINDING QATAR JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENT TO ADVANCE MODULAR GTL DEPLOYMENT
top.summary: Greenway Technologies (GWTI) announced a binding pre-incorporation joint venture agreement with Qatar-based Lone Star Al Serdal to establish GWTI Greenway Technologies Qatar. The joint venture will focus on developing and deploying Greenway's modular gas-to-liquids (GTL) technology in Qatar, with future opportunities for hydrogen and methanol production. Greenway will own 49% of the company but receive 62.5% of net distributable cash. The agreement includes a structured 12-month commercialization program with performance targets including three strategic introductions within 90 days and two proof-of-concept opportunities by month six.

During the week of November 2-6, the company repurchased 150,947 shares on exchange at an average price of €82.03 and 152,860 shares from Heineken Holding N.V.

top.title: Paracetamol Market to Exceed USD 15 Billion by 2032 Driven by Rising Demand for Pain Relief and Fever Management, Reports Mordor Intelligence
top.summary: The global paracetamol market is projected to grow from USD 12.05 billion in 2026 to USD 15.39 billion by 2032, registering a CAGR of 4.12%. Growth is driven by rising demand for pain and fever management, expanding over-the-counter medicine access, and manufacturing capacity investments. Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region, while North America maintains the largest market share at 33.68%. However, generic competition and pricing pressure continue to influence supplier margins.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA) alleging that the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts during the period of June 29, 2026 to September 1, 2026. The complaint alleges undisclosed supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, a false Claims Act investigation related to cybersecurity compliance on government contracts, and that positive statements about the company lacked reasonable basis. Investors who suffered losses may be eligible to recover damages, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 23, 2026.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Triller Group Inc. (OTCMKTS: ILLR) – Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Triller Group Inc. (ILLR) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims Triller made false statements about its control of BKFC, failed to timely file financial reports due to accounting issues, faced delisting risk from NASDAQ, and overstated its ability to resolve non-compliance issues. Investors who purchased securities between October 16, 2024 and December 29, 2025 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 14, 2026.

top.title: APP DEADLINE NOTICE: ROSEN, A TOP RANKED LAW FIRM, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has announced securities class action lawsuits against AppLovin Corporation, Alphabet Inc., and Triller Group Inc., with November 16, 2026 as the lead plaintiff deadline. The AppLovin lawsuit alleges the company made false statements regarding AI video creative features, overstated AI model improvements, and misrepresented the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition.

top.title: 인그리디언 (Ingredion), 2026년 3분기 실적 발표
top.summary: Ingredion reported Q3 2026 results with a 19% decline in operating income year-over-year, missing expectations. The company cited challenges from the Argo facility's slower-than-expected recovery, rising input costs, and weakening consumer demand. However, the Texture & Healthful Solutions segment showed positive momentum with 10 consecutive quarters of volume growth driven by clean label product demand. The company lowered its full-year 2026 guidance, expecting double-digit declines in operating income.

top.title: Ingredion Incorporated 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩
top.summary: Ingredion reported Q3 2026 results with net sales declining 1% and operating income down 19% year-over-year. The company's Texture & Healthful Solutions segment achieved its 10th consecutive quarter of net sales growth, but profitability was pressured by rising input costs, manufacturing challenges at the Argo facility, and weak consumer demand. The company lowered its full-year 2026 guidance, citing slower-than-expected financial recovery at Argo and elevated operating costs.

top.title: イングレディオン・インコーポレーテッド、2026年第3四半期の決算を発表
top.summary: Ingredion Incorporated reported Q3 2026 results with disappointing performance, missing expectations due to delayed financial recovery at Argo, rising raw material costs, and weakening consumer demand. The company lowered full-year 2026 guidance, with reported and adjusted operating income down 19% year-over-year. However, the Texture & Healthful Solutions segment showed strength with 10 consecutive quarters of volume growth driven by clean label demand.

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (NASDAQ: LINC) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements about its business operations, specifically regarding its admissions process failing to effectively convert enrolled students into actual starts, resulting in a significant drop in student enrollment. Investors who purchased LINC securities between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026 are encouraged to join the case.

top.title: Lead Plaintiff Deadlines in Shareholder Class Action Lawsuits Against Lincoln Educational Services (LINC), FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL), and AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS) Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC
top.summary: Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced lead plaintiff deadlines for multiple shareholder class action lawsuits. Lincoln Educational Services faces allegations of false statements regarding student enrollment (deadline Nov 10, 2026). FuelCell Energy is accused of misrepresenting manufacturing capacity and financial risks (deadline Nov 10, 2026). AST SpaceMobile faces claims of misleading statements about capital adequacy and liquidity (deadline Nov 13, 2026).

top.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Everest Group, Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - EG
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors about multiple ongoing securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves Everest Group, Ltd., where investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025 may be entitled to compensation. The lawsuit alleges Everest made false statements about casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves. Additional class actions are mentioned for Lincoln Educational Services Corporation and Dun & Bradstreet Holdings, Inc., with a November 10, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Marea Therapeutics, a Subsidiary of Lisata Therapeutics, Announces MAR001 Reduces Triglycerides Without Worsening Glycemic Control in Phase 2b TYDAL-TIMI 78 Trial; Results Presented as AHA 2026 Late-Breaker and Published in The New England Journal of Medicine
top.summary: Marea Therapeutics, a subsidiary of Lisata Therapeutics, announced that MAR001, a monoclonal antibody targeting ANGPTL4, met all objectives in Phase 2b TYDAL-TIMI 78 trial for severe hypertriglyceridemia treatment. The drug achieved placebo-adjusted triglyceride reductions of 39.1%-45.5% across doses at Week 12, with up to 72.2% reduction in participants with baseline triglycerides ≥500 mg/dL. The drug demonstrated a favorable safety profile with no worsening of HbA1c. Results were presented at AHA 2026 and published in The New England Journal of Medicine.

Privosegtor, a neuroprotective therapy for optic neuritis and other neuro-axonal diseases, is advancing through the PIONEER program with an anticipated IND application approval this quarter. top.title: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico Reports a Passenger Traffic Decrease in October 2026 of 7.0% Compared to 2025
top.summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) reported a 7.0% decrease in total passenger traffic across its 12 Mexican airports in October 2026 compared to October 2025. Major airports like Puerto Vallarta (-19.8%), Tijuana (-14.4%), and Los Cabos (-4.6%) experienced significant declines, though Guadalajara saw only a 1.3% decrease. Year-to-date traffic through October 2026 declined 4.5% compared to the same period in 2025. Load factors remained relatively stable at 81.0% in October 2026 versus 80.7% in October 2025.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Canada launches the Real-Time Rail, bringing 24/7 payment infrastructure to the national economy
top.summary: Payments Canada launched Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR), a new national payment system enabling instant clearing and settlement of payments 24/7. The system is projected to generate $14.5 billion in cost savings and $16-27 billion in economic gains. Initial participants include Wealthsimple, Questbank, Peoples Trust Company, Paramount Commerce, KOHO, DoBusiness.com, Digital Commerce Bank, and Bank of America Canada, with major Canadian financial institutions expected to join within the first year.

top.title: Security National Financial Corporation Reports Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
top.summary: Security National Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: SNFCA) reported Q3 2026 after-tax earnings of $6.166 million, down 38.6% from $10.048 million in Q3 2025. Nine-month earnings declined 10.8% to $22.149 million. The decline was driven by challenging market conditions across all three segments: the Mortgage Segment posted a $2.65 million loss due to reduced volumes and geopolitical headwinds, the Life Insurance Segment faced a 90 basis point portfolio yield decline, and the Cemetery/Mortuary Segment saw profits decline 17%. However, stockholders' equity increased $36 million (8.2%) to $469 million in the quarter, primarily due to favorable accounting treatment of interest rate increases on insurance liabilities.

top.summary: Tiziana Life Sciences announced positive topline results from its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, for treating non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS). The 50 μg dose met the primary endpoint with statistically significant reduction in microglial activation on TSPO PET imaging (p=0.0168) and showed clinically meaningful improvements in fatigue scores. Results were consistent with longer-term data from an expanded access program treating up to 14 patients for up to three years, with favorable safety profile and no anti-drug antibodies detected.

top.summary: Valneva reported positive long-term antibody persistence data for its chikungunya vaccine IXCHIQ®, with 94% of participants maintaining neutralizing antibody levels five years after a single dose. The persistence was comparable across age groups (18-64 years and 65+ years), supporting the vaccine's differentiated profile for a disease with unpredictable epidemic outbreaks. The company continues to generate real-world evidence through post-commercialization studies, including a pilot vaccination campaign in Brazil that vaccinated approximately 80,000 adults.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: FRVO Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Fervo Energy Company, You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Fervo Energy Company (NASDAQ: FRVO) for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses. Additional class actions are also being pursued against Yiren Digital Ltd., Tenax Therapeutics, Inc., Better Home & Finance Holding Company, and AppLovin Corporation.

top.title: ROSEN, THE FIRST FILING FIRM, Encourages Yiren Digital Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - YRD
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Yiren Digital Ltd. (NYSE: YRD) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 29, 2026 and October 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made false and misleading statements regarding CreditEase's financial distress, credit risk exposure, and undisclosed legal and regulatory risks faced by controlling shareholder Ning Tang. Investors must move the court by December 28, 2026 to serve as lead plaintiff.
